text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Joining from the Triple Tiara route, Sweep 
Tosho suppressed a field of formidable 
rivals to seize a brilliant 1st place 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence fell over the venue, followed by 
delayed cheers and thunderous applause. 
That very moment stood as a testament to 
the greatness of what Sweep Tosho had 
accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because she was facing 
the ultimate hero, Zenno Rob Roy, that 
Sweep Tosho was able to weave her greatest 
racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, an article written about the 
Takarazuka Kinen described it as being "as 
if cast under a spell."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the word "magic," Sweep Tosho 
smiled with an innocent grin that was rare 
for her.
